items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: we were nothing but school sweethearts, but I went on with Blanche from then on in.

ctx.x: classes and everything, what was going on, and then what really hurt me so they thought that although I couldn't come to class, that I could come to all the band rehearsals and any performances but the school said no, he can't take part in anything on the campus.

Captain Dryer said it won't be long, a week. So sure enough, the week did pass and we went on back and everything and got back in school and all that is over and I don't know, got to be around with this other girl, Blanche, I believe it was Blanche Franklin, and Agnew kind of got wind of that and she got to thinking about how--
